def transform(grid):
    # Connect each marker into a compact rectilinear tree, routing each nearest
    # pair through an elbow and retaining all original marker cells.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    n=len(pts); parent=list(range(n))
    def root(x):
        while parent[x]!=x:
            parent[x]=parent[parent[x]]; x=parent[x]
        return x
    edges=sorted((abs(pts[i][0]-pts[j][0])+abs(pts[i][1]-pts[j][1]),i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n))
    for _,i,j in edges:
        a,b=root(i),root(j)
        if a==b: continue
        parent[a]=b
        r,c=pts[i]; rr,cc=pts[j]
        # Choose the elbow that adds the fewest new cells to existing network.
        routes=[[(r,x) for x in range(min(c,cc),max(c,cc)+1)]+[(y,cc) for y in range(min(r,rr),max(r,rr)+1)],
                [(y,c) for y in range(min(r,rr),max(r,rr)+1)]+[(rr,x) for x in range(min(c,cc),max(c,cc)+1)]]
        def cost(route): return sum(1 for y,x in set(route) if out[y][x]==0)
        route=min(routes,key=cost)
        for y,x in route:
            if out[y][x]==0: out[y][x]=3
    return out
